name: Rocco
description:
Rocco is a goofy, big-hearted boxer who greets everyone like an old friend. He knows sit, down and paw, and he will offer all three at once if he thinks there is a treat involved.

He walks well on a leash, loves a game of tug and is happiest with a family that will take him on long weekend walks. He has met calm dogs at the shelter and got along with all of them.

name: Cocoa
description:
Cocoa came to us when her family moved overseas. She is a gentle, steady girl who has lived with children and a cat, and she settles quickly in a new place.

She would love a yard to sniff around and someone to throw a ball for her, though she will happily trade the game for a nap at your feet.

name: Sunny
description:
Sunny lives up to her name. She is bright, bouncy and still learning her manners, and she is working on house training with our volunteers.

An application for Sunny is being reviewed. Ask us about her siblings in foster care.

name: Maple
description:
Maple is a sweet, slightly shy girl who warms up fast once she knows you have snacks. She loves car rides and will lean her whole weight against your legs for a scratch.

She chases cats, so she needs a home without them.

name: Juno
description:
Juno has the biggest smile in the building. She is clever, food-motivated and already knows a dozen tricks, including a very convincing bow.

She would like to be the only dog in her home, where she can have all of your attention.

name: Duke
special_needs_detail: Takes a daily joint supplement for mild arthritis.
description:
Duke is a distinguished gentleman with a grey muzzle and a soft spot for blankets. He likes short walks, long naps and anyone who will rub his ears.

He takes a joint supplement with breakfast and is otherwise in good health for his age. Our senior pets are offered at a reduced fee.

name: Waffles
description:
Waffles follows his nose everywhere, so a securely fenced yard is a must. He is friendly with people of every age and adores other dogs.

He has a classic beagle voice and will use it to tell you dinner is late.

name: Oreo
description:
Oreo is the outgoing half of a bonded pair with his brother Domino. He is first to the door, first to the food bowl and first to investigate any open cupboard.

The brothers have never been apart and must be adopted together.

name: Domino
description:
Domino is the calmer brother. He prefers a warm lap and a quiet room, and he relaxes when Oreo is nearby.

The brothers have never been apart and must be adopted together.

name: Luna
description:
Luna is chatty, curious and very fond of high places. Expect her to supervise your cooking from the top of the fridge.

She has lived happily with other cats but is nervous around dogs.

name: Willow
description:
Willow has striking blue eyes and a silky coat that needs brushing a few times a week, which she tolerates for the treats that follow.

She is playful and gentle, and she would do well in almost any home.

name: Clementine
special_needs_detail: FIV positive. Healthy, but best as an only cat or with other FIV-positive cats.
description:
Clementine is a round, regal lady who knows exactly what she wants: a sunny window and dinner at six. She is affectionate on her own terms and purrs like an engine.

She is FIV positive. That sounds scarier than it is: FIV cats live long, normal lives, and our staff are happy to talk it through.

name: Shadow
description:
Shadow is a laid-back cat with golden eyes and a habit of following people from room to room.

He is on hold while he finishes a course of dental treatment and will be available again soon.

name: Marmalade
description:
Marmalade is a big orange cat with a big orange personality. He likes everyone, including the dog he lived with before he came to us.

He is a professional napper and an enthusiastic eater, so his new family will need to keep an eye on the treats.

name: Smokey
description:
Smokey was found living in a garden and is still learning that people are good news. He takes a little time, but once he trusts you he is a devoted companion.

A quiet home with patient adults would suit him best.

name: Pippin
description:
Pippin is a litter-trained lop with soft ears and a love of fresh parsley. He enjoys gentle petting and will happily explore a rabbit-proofed room.

Rabbits live for eight to twelve years, so he is looking for a family ready for the long haul.
